# apple_app_asset_library_reference_data (Data Source)

Reads the App Asset Library's reference data: the placement groups placements can target, the specifications images and videos must meet, and how many placements of each type a group takes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_asset_library_reference_data" "all" {}

output "iphone_groups" {
  value = [for g in data.apple_app_asset_library_reference_data.all.placement_groups : g.id if g.platform == "IPHONE_APP_STORE"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `image_specs` (Attributes List) Image specifications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--image_specs))
- `placement_groups` (Attributes List) Placement groups, for `placement_group`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--placement_groups))
- `placement_policies` (Attributes List) Limits on the placements of a type, per feature. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--placement_policies))
- `video_specs` (Attributes List) Video specifications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--video_specs))

<a id="nestedatt--image_specs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `image_specs`

Read-Only:

- `aspect_ratio` (String) Aspect ratio, e.g. `9:19.5`.
- `compatible_placement_types` (Set of String) Placement types that accept the image.
- `file_extensions` (Set of String) Accepted file extensions.
- `max_file_size` (Number) Maximum file size in bytes.
- `max_height` (Number) Maximum height in pixels.
- `max_width` (Number) Maximum width in pixels.
- `min_height` (Number) Minimum height in pixels.
- `min_width` (Number) Minimum width in pixels.
- `short_name` (String) Name of the specification.
- `spec_id` (String) ID of the image specification.


<a id="nestedatt--placement_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `placement_groups`

Read-Only:

- `display_class` (String) Display class of the group's devices.
- `id` (String) ID of the placement group, e.g. `IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE`.
- `platform` (String) App Store the group shows on, e.g. `IPHONE_APP_STORE`.


<a id="nestedatt--placement_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `placement_policies`

Read-Only:

- `feature` (String) Feature the limit applies to, e.g. `APP_STORE_VERSIONS`.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) Placement groups the limit applies to.
- `max_count` (Number) Maximum number of placements in each group.
- `placement_type` (String) Placement type the limit applies to.


<a id="nestedatt--video_specs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `video_specs`

Read-Only:

- `aspect_ratio` (String) Aspect ratio, e.g. `9:19.5`.
- `compatible_placement_types` (Set of String) Placement types that accept the video.
- `file_extensions` (Set of String) Accepted file extensions.
- `max_file_size` (Number) Maximum file size in bytes.
- `max_height` (Number) Maximum height in pixels.
- `max_width` (Number) Maximum width in pixels.
- `min_height` (Number) Minimum height in pixels.
- `min_width` (Number) Minimum width in pixels.
- `short_name` (String) Name of the specification.
- `spec_id` (String) ID of the video specification.
